shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && echo '--- App.tsx ---' && cat src/App.tsx && echo '--- main.tsx ---' && cat src/main.tsx && echo '--- index.html ---' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -c 'ls -la && test -d node_modules && echo HAS_NODE_MODULES || echo NO_NODE_MODULES; find node_modules/@gravity-ui -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort'

/bin/bash -c "find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 3 -type f -print -exec echo '---' \\; -exec sed -n '1,200p' {} \\; 2>/dev/null | head -300; echo '--- tsconfig ---'; cat tsconfig.json; echo '--- vite ---'; cat vite.config.ts; cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -name 'index.d.ts' | head; echo '---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo '--- i18n pkg ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n -maxdepth 3 -name '*.d.ts' | head"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"export type ControlGroupOption\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head; rg -n \"ControlGroupOption\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls -g '*.d.ts' | head"
